About this item

  • 𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐂𝐇𝐎𝐎𝐒𝐄 𝐀𝐇𝐀𝐌 𝐕𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐅𝐈𝐃𝐄 𝐀𝐈𝐑 𝐏𝐔𝐑𝐈𝐅𝐈𝐄𝐑𝐒: AHAM (Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers) is an ANSI-accredited organization that sets strict standards for appliance performance. Air purifiers with the AHAM VERIFIDE seal have been independently tested for air cleaning performance and energy efficiency. When you choose an AHAM certified air purifier, you're choosing a product trusted for reliable and effective indoor air quality improvement
  • 𝐆𝐄𝐍𝐔𝐈𝐍𝐄 𝐑𝐄𝐏𝐋𝐀𝐂𝐄𝐌𝐄𝐍𝐓 𝐅𝐈𝐋𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐒: For the best performance and longest lifespan, use genuine Levoit replacement filters. Use the in-app feature to monitor your filter life
  • 𝐄𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐈𝐕𝐄 𝐏𝐔𝐑𝐈𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍: 360° Air Intake and a compact design ensure optimal airflow for everyday use. The Core 200S-P is equipped with a high-efficiency motor and refreshes the air in a 140 ft² room 4.8 times per hour. Lightweight yet powerful – perfect for bedrooms, nurseries, offices, or apartments
  • 𝐈𝐌𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐕𝐄𝐃 𝐅𝐈𝐋𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍: While the Nylon Pre-Filter and High-Efficiency Activated Carbon Filter capture large particles and absorb odors and fumes, the Main Filter removes 99.97% of dust, pollen, and dander 0.1-0.3 microns in size
  • 𝐐𝐔𝐈𝐄𝐓 𝐎𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍: With noise levels as low as 27dB, the Core 200S-P cleans your air without disturbing you. For uninterrupted comfort, turn off all lights with the Display Off button

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the air purifier effective, quiet, and reasonably priced, with one noting it exceeds expectations. Moreover, the device improves air quality by moving lots of air and making it feel fresh and clean, while effectively reducing odors from smoking. Additionally, customers report it provides good allergy relief, with one mentioning it helps with bedroom allergens, and they appreciate its relatively small size that works well in both small and large rooms.

5 out of 5 stars
Compact and useful HEPA filter; I've purchased two for bedrooms & travel
If you want a HEPA filter for a bedroom or for travel (by auto or when you can afford to carry LARGE suitcases, like on a cruise), the Levoit 200S is a great choice. Though another reviewer had the 200S confiscated by a cruise company, we were able to take ours aboard a ship in August 2022. We contacted the cruise line (Holland America Line) ahead of time by email, packed the 200S in its original box with the certification circled in Sharpie to highlight it, and also wrote "FAN, no heat!" on the box with a pen. (We taped the email where HAL told us it would be okay to use on the ship to the box, and also taped a cruise line issued luggage tag to the box for identification.) HAL inspected the unit as part of the checked luggage process, and it appeared in our room without any issue or further communication alongside our other luggage. The 200S in its box will fit in a large (deep) checked suitcase or an oversized tote bag. It isn't too heavy to carry, even for someone with arthritic joints, but it is rather bulky. For home use, anyone of any age or health status should be able to carry this to the desired room and set it up. All users should note that the filter is WRAPPED IN PLASTIC when the unit is brand new. If you don't unwrap the filter inside the plastic casing, your 200S will be totally unable to filter any allergens. Double check this upon receipt, though a sticker on the unit did remind me to take this step when I first unboxed my 200S HEPA machines. For a cruise stateroom, one of the top features of the 200S model in particular is the built in nightlight. My kids were in an inside cabin with no natural light, and the small nightlight was helpful at night. One of my teens will take this to college for use in a dorm, and the feature may also be good there. I tried a Levoit Mini, which is a nicer size for travel, but it is too small for most bedrooms and the lack of nightlight made me prefer to pack the larger 200S for our cruise. (I've added a photo showing the Levoit 200S stacked below the Levoit Mini along with a tiny PURE HEPA for size comparison for those seeking a travel HEPA option.) Best of all, the nightlight on the 200S is only a feature, and it can be shut off with a tap. The operating lights (glowing touchscreen "buttons") CAN ALSO BE TURNED OFF COMPLETELY, so this unit will run absolutely dark. If light bothers you when you sleep, as it does me, this is perfect. Switching the button lights off does make is somewhat harder to find the correct spot to tap to adjust the speed or turn the lights back on, but I only do this once per day typically, so it is well worth the tradeoff. The Levoit 200S will run totally dark, but there will always be a whirring fan noise because air movement is necessary for the filtration to occur. My kids dislike white noise and run the machine on low when they sleep. I find white noise soothing, and usually keep the unit in my bedroom on setting 2 of 3. If allergens seem bad, or during the day on the cruise ship when the cleaners would enter the room, we run the noisier setting 3 for maximum filtration. It's hard to quantify how well these remove allergens compared to other units, but I've seen good reviews of a related model in Wirecutter so I'm optimistic. Certainly, these are lighter in weight and more aesthetically pleasing than the Honeywell models I used back in the 1980's, though the old metal shells felt sturdier than today's plastic ones. No HEPA filter can work properly if it is undersized to the room, but combining two (or more) small machines in a larger room is an option. Having the internal fan pull in air at multiple points can actually work better than one stronger fan operating to one side of a large or irregularly shaped room. Since my bedroom is larger than the kids', we run two units to reduce allergens there, one one either side of our king sized bed. This isn't the model to buy if you want it to work alone in a large room, but it is reasonable for most small to moderately sized bedrooms. The larger the room, the higher the fan setting you'll need for it to be effective. Only air that passes through the filter has allergens removed from it. I've never bothered with the Smart features on this model. Since I'm trying to reduce allergens where I sleep, I can easily reach the controls. I use the nightlight as I get ready for bed and to walk from the bathroom without bright lights on, then I switch that off and climb into bed in full darkness. For me, this model is perfect.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Skeptical About Used? This Changed My Mind
    Reviewed in the United States on April 5, 2026
    Size: Standard 1 PackSet name: Core 200S-P White
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I chose the Amazon box option mainly so I could check whether the item shipped safely and arrived without damage to the outer packaging. The Amazon box itself arrived in good condition, but the Core 200S-P’s box was damaged, likely because it had not been handled carefully during a previous shipment.

    Since I bought it in Used – Acceptable condition, I inspected the purifier carefully. I found no issues with the unit itself. It came with what appears to be a new filter, had no strange smell, and works perfectly, just like my other Core 300S-P, which I recently bought new.

    I also bought a second unit in Used – Good condition. The only thing I noticed was a black scuff mark on the bottom of the purifier, as shown in the pictures, but it does not look like actual damage. The box for that one also appeared to have been damaged during a previous shipment. From my experience buying used items on Amazon, that seems fairly common, and it is probably one reason the price is lower when the manufacturer’s box is damaged.

    I ran it for an hour on level 3, the highest fan speed and it seems to be working perfectly. Afterward, the room smelled cleaner and felt easier to breathe in. I also found no visual issues.

    After comparing it side by side with the Core 300S-P, I honestly think the Core 200S-P is a better fit for bedrooms, while the Core 300S-P is better suited for larger rooms. Overall, it was definitely a steal at $53.36 for both of the units and I’m very satisfied with this purchase. 🙏

    Update after 2 weeks: I’ve just check the filters it also surprising picks up more than just dust, it picks up tiny mosquito!!! 🦟 we have left the living room sliding door open because of the renovation so this is proof to be a life saving from these annoying little pest

    Great small sized air purifier that does some heavy lifting
    Reviewed in the United States on January 6, 2026
    Size: Standard 1 PackSet name: Core 200S-P White
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I got this air purifier for my bedroom as my sleep can be disturbed by air quality pretty easily. I was highly skeptical of this product at first as the price point to me indicated that it might be cheap in terms of quality of the product but so far it has been pretty impressive. On even the lowest setting, it has substantially improved the air quality not just in the bedroom but in the adjoining room so we're looking at space of about 200-300 square feet or so. I would say I can breathe easier at night with it and my comfort level while sleeping has increased a bit.

    The air after it's been running for a bit smells and just seems fresher and I am considering getting a second one to see if it can handle a much larger area.

    Noise is pretty low on it's lowest "normal" setting and the night mode feature drops the noise to almost silent, but not quite. At it's lowest setting, there is an odd whine, for lack of better words that can just barely be heard. This whine was an annoyance at first but you get used to and can ignore it. It still works well on the lowest setting to keep the room fresh so it's a good deal.

    Setup was easy as can physically, however I cannot as yet speak to the application setup as I haven't gotten to that. I treat air purifiers as non-smart devices but I do plan to at least try to integrate it with Home Assistant and if that doesn't work I may try integration with Amazon Alexa. I'll update the review when that happens.

    Durability of the purifier long term is unknown, though the filters do seem very easy to replace and their price point does make them economical enough to justify getting a filter instead of replacing the entire air purifier.

    Summary: Good, powerful little air purifier that can sit on a dresser or nightstand, relatively quiet with some caveats. Long term durability is unknown but still was a good buy overall.

  • Lisa C
    5 out of 5 stars
    Affordable and effective for dust and allergens
    Reviewed in the United States on December 14, 2023
    Size: Standard 1 PackSet name: Vital 100 Cream White
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    We moved into an incredibly dusty townhouse, I have terrible allergies, and we discovered our neighbors are chain smokers. We now have 3 Levoit air purifiers in our home: Vital 100 (non-smart version), Core Mini and Vital 200S.

    I initially bought the Vital 100 and put it in our bedroom because I have terrible allergies. It collected a ton of dust and helped a lot with the allergies. I thought I didn't need the smart version but in hindsight the availability of specialty filters and the remote control would be very helpful. It's relatively quiet although on high it's too noisy for me to sleep with. I absolutely love that you can turn the all the control lights off. We tried using this for the cigarette smell but it wasn't very effective except when the smell was very light. It did completely abolish cooking smells though. If I could go back in time I would have ordered the 100S instead but this one works fine.

    The smoke smell from the neighbors comes into our house through the laundry room which is a very small room. I bought the Core Mini to try to combat it. The Core Mini doesn't really do much to get rid of smells and was definitely overwhelmed by the smoke so now we move it around the house now when the pollen level is high. It works ok for dust and allergens but the range isn't great; you need to be right next to it to notice a difference. On low and medium speed it's barely audible and high is relatively quiet but overall the fan isn't very powerful. The lights on this one automatically turn off after a few seconds making it bedroom friendly. If I could do it again, I would have skipped this one and bought one of the larger ones sooner.

    Lastly, in an attempt to mitigate the smoke coming from next door, we got the big boi Vital 200S with the add on smoke specialty filter. So far it isn't able to remove the smell while they're smoking but it does cut down the severity and will clear it eventually provided the source stops for long enough. It's amazingly quiet on the lower speeds. It's pretty loud on the higher speeds but the fan moves a ton of air around. I'm disappointed that the auto mode doesn't detect the smoke smell but I can use the app to turn it to high speed as soon as I smell it. You don't have to use the app but it's really easy to set up and connect. The app allows you to set schedules which is really handy and as I touched on earlier, it works as a remote control. As with the others, you're able to turn the lights off completely so it's good for bedrooms. We've only had this running a few days but I'm pretty impressed with what it can do.

    5 out of 5 stars
    1000% RECOMMEND!
    Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2025
    Size: Standard 1 PackSet name: Core 200S-P Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I bought this purifier because I really wanted one that I could turn on from my phone while laying in bed, since I am completely blind in the dark due to my vision impairment, and I don't necessarily have anywhere to place this type of electronic near my bed that was the major deal breaker for me. This air purifier is about the size of a PS5, but a little more convenient due to the cylinidrical shape of it. The app set up is easy and it allows you to auto order a new filter through the app via a scheduled set up. I have mine set up for every 6 months and you can tell the difference between the 2 filters after those 6 months.... the app also will tell you the life on your filter left and will tell you the air quality/ pollen count outside of your home. All the modes do exactly as they say and the sleep mode is ultra quiet which is nice. I've been using this air purifier for almost 2 years now and it is still working great. You can immidetly tell when you take it out of the box that it is a good high quality purifier and not a purifier where they say its high quality and after a week it stops working... My last purifier was lmof a lower quality and stopped working with-in a year, but also I paid $50 for that one and I didn't have a dog at that time.

    It is so nice to have a higher quality purifier that works exactly as it says on the ads. The app also includes other Levoit electronics you can add to your account so you have all your Lwvoit products in one spot on your phone which I think is so mice and easy. The app is also really easy to use and to set up everything on, it looks and feels very professional and easy which I really enjoy. I love opening up my app and seeing all my Levoit electronics in one spot, ready to turn on or off, or to change any mode it's on to something different. You can aslo set up a schedule of when you would like your devices to turn on and off and what mode to use whenbit does.

    The purifier has been so helpful with my allergies as it takes about 10 minutes for my severe allergy symptoms to begin subsiding a good amount after coming inside from walking the dog. To some 10 minutes may sound like a long time, but to someone with really really REALLY awful allergies 10 minutes is well worth the wait...

    Also, the air suction is powerful enough where I have to wipe I'm purifier down with a clean and dry paper towel to get some dog hair off of the sides where the air flows into the machine. It's also kept the infamous "dog smell" from settling in my room. I highly recommend this purifier it's great and if/when this one goes, I will definitly be purchasing another Levoit brand...

    Size: Standard 1 PackSet name: Core 200S-P White
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    Je ne sais pas par où commencer, mais en tout cas, je suis super satisfait. L'appareil a un joli design et on sent la qualité. Sur l'écran tactile, il y a tout ce qu'il faut.

    Ce que j'adore, c'est le fait qu'il soit connecté à l'application. Elle est vraiment super simple et complète sans en faire trop. On peut voir sur les photos qu'il est indiqué quand il faut changer le filtre (par exemple, il affiche 100 % quand il est neuf) ; on peut donc suivre son état d'usure au fur et à mesure.

    En plus, juste en dessous, tout est prévu :

    1. Il y a un lien « acheter le filtre »

    2. Ce lien vous redirige directement sur Amazon

    3. Le filtre coûte actuellement 25 €, ce qui n'est pas trop cher puisqu'il faut le changer tous les 3 à 6 mois

    C'est vraiment bien pensé. La notice est en français, mais j'avoue qu'on n'en a pas vraiment besoin car tout est expliqué étape par étape dans l'application.

    L'appareil dispose de 3 modes :

    1. Mode silencieux

    2. Mode moyen

    3. Mode fort : utile pour purifier une pièce rapidement (pendant une demi-heure par exemple) avant de baisser la puissance. En mode fort, le ventilateur s'entend forcément assez fort, mais c'est pour l'efficacité. En mode moyen ou silencieux, on ne l'entend presque plus.

    Il y a même un mode veilleuse (on peut le voir sur une de mes photos) qui diffuse une petite lumière la nuit. On peut également désactiver tous les voyants si c'est gênant, par exemple dans une chambre d'enfant.

    Pour l'instant, je suis très satisfait et je recommande mon achat.

On peut voir sur les photos qu'il est indiqué quand il faut changer le filtre (par exemple, il affiche 100 % quand il est neuf) ; on peut donc suivre son état d'usure au fur et à mesure.

    En plus, juste en dessous, tout est prévu :

    1. Il y a un lien « acheter le filtre »

    2. Ce lien vous redirige directement sur Amazon

    3. Le filtre coûte actuellement 25 €, ce qui n'est pas trop cher puisqu'il faut le changer tous les 3 à 6 mois

    C'est vraiment bien pensé. La notice est en français, mais j'avoue qu'on n'en a pas vraiment besoin car tout est expliqué étape par étape dans l'application.

    L'appareil dispose de 3 modes :

    1. Mode silencieux

    2. Mode moyen

    3. Mode fort : utile pour purifier une pièce rapidement (pendant une demi-heure par exemple) avant de baisser la puissance. En mode fort, le ventilateur s'entend forcément assez fort, mais c'est pour l'efficacité. En mode moyen ou silencieux, on ne l'entend presque plus.

    Il y a même un mode veilleuse (on peut le voir sur une de mes photos) qui diffuse une petite lumière la nuit. On peut également désactiver tous les voyants si c'est gênant, par exemple dans une chambre d'enfant.

    Pour l'instant, je suis très satisfait et je recommande mon achat.
